summary: I read the complete-cart path and the reserve-inventory step. The step wraps createReservationItems in locking.execute, and with default settings Medusa uses InMemoryLockingProvider (packages/modules/locking/src/providers/in-memory.ts), so the lock is process-local and cannot serialize two servers sharing one database. I submitted two attempts: a cross-server SOLO race (process-local-lock) and a single cart mixing two WIDGET variants that may exceed stock (per-line-check). No run results were returned to me in this session, so neither is confirmed; the process-local-lock claim rests on code reading only.
